from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, Inches, RGBColor
from docx.enum.section import WD_ORIENT
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

NAVY = "1F3864"
LIGHT = "D9E2F3"
GREY = "F2F2F2"

def new_doc(landscape=False):
    d = Document()
    sec = d.sections[0]
    if landscape:
        sec.orientation = WD_ORIENT.LANDSCAPE
        sec.page_width, sec.page_height = Inches(11), Inches(8.5)
    else:
        sec.page_width, sec.page_height = Inches(8.5), Inches(11)
    for m in ("left_margin", "right_margin"):
        setattr(sec, m, Inches(0.7))
    sec.top_margin = Inches(0.7)
    sec.bottom_margin = Inches(0.7)
    st = d.styles["Normal"]
    st.font.name = "Calibri"
    st.font.size = Pt(10)
    st.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"), "Calibri")
    for name, size in (("Heading 1", 14), ("Heading 2", 12), ("Heading 3", 11)):
        h = d.styles[name]
        h.font.name = "Calibri"
        h.font.size = Pt(size)
        h.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x1F, 0x38, 0x64)
    return d

def usable_width(d):
    s = d.sections[0]
    return s.page_width - s.left_margin - s.right_margin

def shade(cell, color):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear")
    shd.set(qn("w:color"), "auto")
    shd.set(qn("w:fill"), color)
    tcPr.append(shd)

def repeat_header(row):
    trPr = row._tr.get_or_add_trPr()
    el = OxmlElement("w:tblHeader")
    el.set(qn("w:val"), "true")
    trPr.append(el)

def no_split(row):
    trPr = row._tr.get_or_add_trPr()
    el = OxmlElement("w:cantSplit")
    el.set(qn("w:val"), "true")
    trPr.append(el)

def add_runs(par, text, size=None, bold_all=False, color=None):
    # supports **bold** segments
    parts = text.split("**")
    for i, p in enumerate(parts):
        if not p:
            continue
        r = par.add_run(p)
        r.bold = bold_all or (i % 2 == 1)
        if size:
            r.font.size = Pt(size)
        if color:
            r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(color)
    return par

def fill_cell(cell, content, size=8.5, bold=False, color=None):
    # content: str (lines split by \n; lines starting with "- " become bullets)
    cell.text = ""
    lines = content.split("\n") if isinstance(content, str) else content
    first = True
    for line in lines:
        if first:
            par = cell.paragraphs[0]
            first = False
        else:
            par = cell.add_paragraph()
        par.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(1)
        par.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
        if line.startswith("- "):
            par.paragraph_format.left_indent = Inches(0.12)
            par.paragraph_format.first_line_indent = Inches(-0.1)
            line = "• " + line[2:]
        add_runs(par, line, size=size, bold_all=bold, color=color)

def set_col_widths(table, widths):
    table.autofit = False
    tbl = table._tbl
    tblPr = tbl.tblPr
    lay = OxmlElement("w:tblLayout")
    lay.set(qn("w:type"), "fixed")
    tblPr.append(lay)
    grid = tbl.tblGrid
    for i, gc in enumerate(grid.findall(qn("w:gridCol"))):
        gc.set(qn("w:w"), str(int(widths[i].twips if hasattr(widths[i], "twips") else widths[i])))
    for row in table.rows:
        for i, c in enumerate(row.cells):
            c.width = widths[i]

def make_table(d, header, rows, widths, size=8.5, header_color=NAVY, zebra=True, first_col_bold=False, first_col_shade=None):
    t = d.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(header))
    t.style = "Table Grid"
    t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    hr = t.rows[0]
    repeat_header(hr)
    for i, h in enumerate(header):
        fill_cell(hr.cells[i], h, size=size, bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
        shade(hr.cells[i], header_color)
    for ri, r in enumerate(rows):
        row = t.add_row()
        for i, val in enumerate(r):
            fill_cell(row.cells[i], val, size=size, bold=(first_col_bold and i == 0))
            if first_col_shade and i == 0:
                shade(row.cells[i], first_col_shade)
            elif zebra and ri % 2 == 1:
                shade(row.cells[i], GREY)
    set_col_widths(t, widths)
    return t

def para(d, text, size=10, style=None, space_after=4, align=None, italic=False):
    p = d.add_paragraph(style=style) if style else d.add_paragraph()
    add_runs(p, text, size=size)
    if italic:
        for r in p.runs:
            r.italic = True
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(space_after)
    if align == "center":
        p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    return p

def bullet(d, text, size=10):
    p = d.add_paragraph(style="List Bullet")
    add_runs(p, text, size=size)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return p

def footer(d, text):
    for s in d.sections:
        f = s.footer.paragraphs[0]
        f.text = ""
        r = f.add_run(text)
        r.font.size = Pt(7.5)
        r.italic = True
        f.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
EOF
